title: Phase 7: OpenCode acceptance and documentation. Depends on Phase 6 (mcp-wire-validate-deployment). Full spec: docs/MCP-PRODUCTION-FIX-PLAN.md
acceptance: with a supported OpenCode version and clean OAuth cache: opencode mcp add commoncal-production --url https://mcal.hajnal.space/mcp, opencode mcp auth commoncal-production, opencode mcp list all succeed
browser login and consent complete; authenticated initialize negotiates a supported protocol version
tools/list returns all nine tools with schemas
calendar_list returns only calendars selected in the grant
narrowing or revoking the grant changes the next call immediately
restarting OpenCode refreshes/re-authorizes without manual token copying
docs/MCP-CONNECTION.md updated only after this proof passes, explaining the OpenCode/LM Studio/Qwen roles and not asking users for JWTs, internal API keys, pod access, or a second MCP client
